description: Historical token prices on Arc, batch: up to 50 token@block pairs, each priced from its deepest Uniswap v4 USDC pool AT that block. For history values, P&L, tax exports. Not one priceable pair = refused before payment. $0.003 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: arc_price_at
